notes.title: Сompatibility Patch (Part 2 of 2) released!
notes.content:
Hello again, fellow sleuths!

We're releasing the long-awaited second part of the compatibility patch.

This patch fixes common startup and save issues of our older games running on Windows 10. 

We hope you can continue enjoying our previous games to the fullest with these new fixes.

Take care!
Frogwares team

tags.bug: This patch fixes common startup and save issues of our older games running on Windows 10.
